name: Goldener Löwe
beschreibung: The Hotel Goldener Löwe is located in the old town of Kufstein, near the fortress. It is a historic building that has served as an inn and guesthouse since the 15th century. The rooms are equipped with a bathroom, TV, and free Wi-Fi. The restaurant serves Tiroler Spezialitäten and international dishes. The wellness area offers a sauna and a relaxation room. Two event rooms are available for conferences and celebrations. The central location makes it possible to explore the city on foot. Hiking trails into the Kaisergebirge also start from here.
